project.name: Anonymous Messaging & Anonymous Chat Telegram Bot

status_definitions.NOT_STARTED: Known work that has not started.
status_definitions.READY: Unblocked and ready to be started.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Existing implementation is verified but incomplete.
status_definitions.IN_PROGRESS: The task currently has active implementation work.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed until a named blocker is resolved.
status_definitions.REVIEW: Implementation is complete enough for validation/review.
status_definitions.DONE: Acceptance criteria were verified with evidence.
status_definitions.SKIPPED: Explicitly out of scope; reason must be documented.

phases.name: Discovery & Baseline
phases.goal: Understand the existing repository before changing it. Build a verified as-is map and compare it with the PRD.

phases.name: Foundation, Identity & Runtime
phases.goal: Establish the bot runtime, durable infrastructure, identity model, consent, state routing, and localization foundation.

phases.name: Profiles & User Settings
phases.goal: Implement the custom matchmaking profile, profile history, validation, completion, visibility, and user preferences.

phases.name: Anonymous Links & Inbox
phases.goal: Implement personal anonymous links, anonymous compose/reply threads, inbox management, and anonymous sender controls.

phases.name: Matchmaking Core
phases.goal: Build eligibility checks, queueing, atomic matching, pair history, repeat-match rules, and profile snapshots.

phases.name: Live Chat & Session Lifecycle
phases.goal: Implement session-scoped relay, Telegram message mapping, active-chat controls, and deterministic session ending.

phases.name: Deletion & Retention
phases.goal: Implement message/session Telegram deletion while preserving the internal archive and audit trail.

phases.name: Coins, Rewards & Referrals
phases.goal: Implement the transactional coin ledger, one-time rewards, referral qualification, and anti-farming guarantees.

phases.name: Moderation & Anti-Abuse
phases.goal: Implement blocking, reports, warnings, restrictions, spam controls, and risk-based abuse defenses.

phases.name: Admin, Archive, Export & Operations UI
phases.goal: Build Telegram-only administrative workflows for investigation, moderation, export, audit, broadcasts, and statistics.

phases.name: Security, Concurrency & Reliability
phases.goal: Harden authorization, transactional behavior, restart safety, Redis failure behavior, workers, backups, and recovery.

phases.name: Observability, Configuration & Analytics
phases.goal: Add logs, monitoring, configuration, feature flags, maintenance mode, analytics events, indexing, and pagination.

phases.name: Phase 2 Product Enhancements
phases.goal: Add protected content, richer media, location/distance matching, advanced filters, history, moderators, and stronger fraud controls.

phases.name: Phase 3 Growth & Monetization
phases.goal: Add optional growth, monetization, recommendation, moderation-assistance, and reputation features only after core safety is stable.

phases.name: Production Readiness & Acceptance
phases.goal: Prove the implementation against the PRD acceptance criteria and operational release requirements.

tasks.title: Repository Reconnaissance
tasks.objective: Inspect the entire repository and create a verified as-is understanding of the codebase before implementation changes.
acceptance: Repository tree and major directories are documented.
Runtime/framework/entrypoints are identified from code, not guessed.
Database, Redis, queues, migrations, tests, deployment and configuration are documented where present.
Implemented vs unknown product modules are noted.
Open questions and evidence gaps are explicitly listed.
tasks.last_note: Initial discovery task selected as the current work item; repository inspection is the next action.

tasks.title: PRD-to-Code Gap Analysis
tasks.objective: Compare the verified repository state against the product/technical PRD and convert findings into an evidence-based implementation plan.
acceptance: Every implementation phase has an Implemented/Partial/Missing/Unknown assessment.
Critical PRD invariants are checked explicitly.
Existing task statuses are updated only when code evidence supports the change.
The next recommended implementation task is selected.
Risks/blockers and unresolved architectural decisions are recorded.

tasks.title: Runtime & Project Skeleton
tasks.objective: Establish or validate the Telegram bot application skeleton, configuration loading, update entrypoint, and environment separation.
acceptance: Bot starts in a development environment.
Secrets are not committed.
Production/staging configuration boundaries are explicit.

tasks.title: PostgreSQL & Redis Foundations
tasks.objective: Create durable PostgreSQL connectivity/migrations and Redis connectivity for transient state, locks, queues, rate limits, and cache.
acceptance: Migrations can run from a clean database.
Redis failure is detectable and fails safely.
No critical durable state exists only in memory.

tasks.title: User Identity & Registration
tasks.objective: Implement internal users, Telegram identity snapshots/history, registration metadata, account state, and last bot activity.
acceptance: Telegram identity is stored internally and never exposed through anonymous views.
Identity changes are tracked where implemented.
last_activity_at reflects bot interaction, not Telegram last-seen.

tasks.title: Terms, Privacy & Age Gate
tasks.objective: Implement versioned acceptance for Terms, Privacy Notice, Community Rules, and the product age policy.
acceptance: Version and acceptance timestamps are stored.
Anonymous/privacy wording does not claim service-level anonymity or E2E encryption.
Age policy is explicit.

tasks.title: Explicit State Machine & Routing
tasks.objective: Implement explicit user states and deterministic incoming-update routing with idempotency protections.
acceptance: Important flows do not infer state from last message text.
Routing priority prevents menu/control messages from leaking to chat partners.
Critical retries do not duplicate registration/reward/match/message effects.

tasks.title: Localization Foundation
tasks.objective: Move user-facing strings and button labels behind translation keys with Persian as an initial supported locale.
acceptance: Business logic does not hard-code Persian text.
RTL/mixed-text constraints are documented for testing.

tasks.title: Custom Profile Data Model
tasks.objective: Implement the separate matchmaking profile model and keep it distinct from Telegram identity.
acceptance: Telegram and custom identities are separate data structures.
Required profile fields match product requirements.

tasks.title: Profile Editing & Validation
tasks.objective: Implement profile editing, field validation, and completion scoring.
acceptance: Invalid age/name/bio/photo/city inputs are rejected consistently.
Completion percentage is deterministic.

tasks.title: Profile Views & Privacy
tasks.objective: Implement owner, public matchmaking, and admin profile projections with privacy controls.
acceptance: Public profile never contains Telegram ID/username/real account data/exact GPS.
Admin view clearly separates Telegram identity and custom profile.

tasks.title: Profile History & Snapshots Support
tasks.objective: Persist profile changes in a form that supports historical admin review and future session snapshots.
acceptance: Historical values are retained with timestamps.
Current profile remains queryable independently of history.

tasks.title: User Settings & Deactivation
tasks.objective: Implement privacy, notification, chat, anonymous settings and account deactivation behavior.
acceptance: Deactivation disables links and matchmaking and handles an active session.
Historical records are retained according to policy.

tasks.title: Anonymous Link Tokens
tasks.objective: Implement secure random anonymous-link tokens, resolution, revocation, and regeneration.
acceptance: Tokens do not reveal Telegram/internal IDs.
Revoked tokens stop resolving.
Link mode does not expose destination profile.

tasks.title: Anonymous Message Compose & Storage
tasks.objective: Implement anonymous compose mode and internal sender/recipient attribution with supported content policy.
acceptance: Recipient never sees sender Telegram identity.
Backend stores sender and recipient when sender is an identified bot user.
Identity-leaking content is disabled or handled by policy.

tasks.title: Anonymous Inbox & Delivery
tasks.objective: Implement inbox delivery, unread/all/replied views, pagination, read state, and hide/delete-visible behavior.
acceptance: Inbox can paginate safely.
User-visible deletion does not remove backend archive.

tasks.title: Anonymous Reply Threads
tasks.objective: Implement anonymous reply threads without creating matchmaking relationships.
acceptance: Replies remain anonymous to both users.
Threading is independent from live matchmaking sessions.

tasks.title: Anonymous Block & Report
tasks.objective: Implement hidden-identity blocking and precise reporting for anonymous senders/messages.
acceptance: Recipient can block without learning sender identity.
Future prohibited anonymous messages are rejected.
Reports preserve precise source references.

tasks.title: Anonymous Abuse Controls
tasks.objective: Add per-sender/per-recipient limits, cooldowns, duplicate detection hooks, and new-account media restrictions.
acceptance: Abusive bursts are limited.
Controls are configurable and observable.

tasks.title: Matchmaking Eligibility
tasks.objective: Implement account/profile/status/coin/rate-limit eligibility checks before queue entry.
acceptance: Banned/inactive/incomplete/already-chatting/already-queued users cannot enter incorrectly.

tasks.title: Match Queue
tasks.objective: Implement Redis-backed queue requests with durable intent/audit where needed.
acceptance: Queue add/cancel is deterministic.
Queue state can fail safely if Redis is unavailable.

tasks.title: User Pair Model
tasks.objective: Implement normalized user-pair history for blocks, repeat matches, cooldowns, and aggregate metadata.
acceptance: Pair ordering is normalized.
Pair state is not used as a substitute for individual sessions.

tasks.title: Atomic Match Creation
tasks.objective: Atomically reserve two candidates, re-check eligibility/blocks, create a brand-new session, snapshot profiles, and release queue state.
acceptance: One user cannot be matched to two people concurrently.
Every successful match creates a new session.
Cancel-vs-match race has deterministic behavior.

tasks.title: Match Preferences & Repeat Rules
tasks.objective: Implement female/male/random selection, allowed filters, repeat-match cooldown/deprioritization, and previous-match handling.
acceptance: Self/block/banned/unavailable matches are impossible.
Female, Male and Random modes work.
Repeat matches create new sessions when allowed.

tasks.title: Match Search UX
tasks.objective: Implement search, cancel, no-candidate, keep-searching and filter navigation states.
acceptance: Search state cannot accidentally forward control messages.
Cancel resolves races consistently with server state.

tasks.title: Chat Session Model & Lifecycle
tasks.objective: Implement session statuses, participant membership, match metadata, end fields, and active-session lookup.
acceptance: Ended sessions are never reopened.
Each active chat maps to exactly one session.

tasks.title: Live Chat Relay
tasks.objective: Implement relay of supported content through the bot with server-side archival.
acceptance: Partner Telegram identity is never exposed.
Control/menu messages are not relayed.
Each archived message belongs to exactly one session.

tasks.title: Telegram Message Mapping
tasks.objective: Persist sender-side and recipient-side Telegram chat/message IDs for every relayed message.
acceptance: Both Telegram copies are addressable later for deletion.
Mapping persists across restarts.

tasks.title: Session System Message Registry
tasks.objective: Track session-related bot/system messages that may need deletion or audit.
acceptance: Match/profile/protected/end notices can be associated with a session and user.

tasks.title: End Chat & Post-Chat Flow
tasks.objective: Implement confirmation, release of participants, deterministic end reason, and post-chat actions.
acceptance: Both users leave active-chat state.
History remains intact.
Find-another/block/report/delete-this-chat actions reference the ended session.

tasks.title: Restart & Reachability Recovery
tasks.objective: Handle bot restarts and Telegram delivery failures without corrupting session state.
acceptance: Restart does not destroy active durable records.
Blocked/unreachable bot users are removed from queue and active chat is handled safely.

tasks.title: Single Message Deletion
tasks.objective: Implement delete-for-both using the exact session message mapping while retaining the database record.
acceptance: Requester membership is verified.
Both Telegram copies are attempted.
Backend record remains archived.

tasks.title: Full Session Deletion
tasks.objective: Implement deletion of Telegram-visible messages for one exact session only.
acceptance: Only selected session mappings are targeted.
Other sessions between the same pair are untouched.
Database archive remains.

tasks.title: Deletion Batching & Limits
tasks.objective: Implement per-chat dedupe, batches of up to 100 IDs, Telegram deletion-limit handling, retries, and partial results.
acceptance: Sessions with >100 messages are processed in multiple batches.
Older/non-deletable messages yield partial status rather than archive loss.

tasks.title: Deletion UX & Audit
tasks.objective: Expose 48-hour limitation warning, result states, and detailed deletion audit records.
acceptance: Warning appears before full deletion.
FULL/PARTIAL/FAILED results are stored and reported.
Deletion actions are auditable.

tasks.title: Coin Ledger
tasks.objective: Implement an append-only transactional coin ledger and derived/current balance.
acceptance: Spends are concurrency-safe.
Every balance change has a ledger record.
No unprotected read-then-subtract flow.

tasks.title: Welcome & Profile Rewards
tasks.objective: Implement one-time registration and profile-completion rewards with anti-farming claims.
acceptance: Each reward type is claimable once per policy.
Remove/re-add profile field does not farm rewards.

tasks.title: Referral Qualification
tasks.objective: Implement referral tokens, qualification, idempotent reward issuance, and basic fraud checks.
acceptance: One referred user cannot trigger duplicate rewards.
Rewards wait for configured qualification.

tasks.title: Match & Filter Costs
tasks.objective: Integrate configurable coin reservations/spends/refunds into paid matchmaking options without breaking basic usability.
acceptance: No double-spend on concurrent actions.
Failed/cancelled paid operations have defined refund behavior.

tasks.title: Coins UI & History
tasks.objective: Implement balance, lifetime earned/spent, paginated history, rewards, and referral entry points.
acceptance: Displayed balances reconcile with ledger.
History is paginated.

tasks.title: Unified Blocking Model
tasks.objective: Implement consistent block semantics across matchmaking, anonymous inbox, and optional anonymous thread continuation.
acceptance: Blocked pairs cannot match while block is active.
Source and session context are preserved where relevant.

tasks.title: Reports & Evidence Precision
tasks.objective: Implement reports for anonymous messages, users, profiles, chat messages, and exact sessions.
acceptance: Reports point to exact session/message/anonymous source where applicable.
Admin can retrieve associated evidence.

tasks.title: Warnings, Restrictions & Bans
tasks.objective: Implement moderation actions, warnings, temporary/permanent restrictions, and product-surface enforcement.
acceptance: Restrictions are enforced server-side.
Moderation history is retained.

tasks.title: Rate Limits & Flood Control
tasks.objective: Implement configurable anonymous/chat/search/referral rate limits and cooldowns.
acceptance: Flooding is limited without relying on in-process memory only.
Limits are configurable.

tasks.title: Risk Signals & Abuse Detection Hooks
tasks.objective: Aggregate reports, blocks, duplicate behavior, account age and other signals into extensible risk checks.
acceptance: Risk controls can influence moderation/search/media limits without exposing private data to users.

tasks.title: Admin Authentication & RBAC
tasks.objective: Implement main admin allowlist plus granular secondary roles/permissions and server-side authorization.
acceptance: Every sensitive admin action checks caller permissions server-side.
Main and secondary privileges are distinguishable.

tasks.title: Admin User Search & User Page
tasks.objective: Implement search by supported identifiers and a separated Telegram/custom-profile user view.
acceptance: Search explains matched identifier.
Telegram identity and custom profile are visually separated.

tasks.title: Admin Session & Message Archive
tasks.objective: Implement session history, exact-session viewer, message pagination, snapshots, deletion indicators, and reports.
acceptance: Old sessions remain independently reviewable.
Deleted-from-Telegram content remains visible in authorized archive if retained.

tasks.title: Admin Anonymous Archive
tasks.objective: Implement sent/received anonymous message and thread inspection with internal identities for authorized admins.
acceptance: Regular users never gain these identity views.
Admin access is permission-checked and auditable.

tasks.title: Exports
tasks.objective: Implement user, exact-session, and optional pair-history exports with authorization and audit.
acceptance: Sessions are not merged in pair history.
Exports are restricted and audited.
Large exports do not block the update handler.

tasks.title: Admin Notes & Audit Log
tasks.objective: Implement private notes and sensitive-action audit logging.
acceptance: Search/view/export/location/coin/moderation/config actions can be audited as required.

tasks.title: Broadcast & Statistics
tasks.objective: Implement segmented broadcasts, delivery stats, and admin-facing product statistics.
acceptance: Broadcast delivery is backgrounded and reports queued/sent/failed states.
Statistics have defined source queries/aggregation.

tasks.title: Callback & Ownership Security
tasks.objective: Harden callback handlers against forged object IDs using identity, permission, ownership, and membership checks.
acceptance: Forged callback IDs cannot access other users/sessions/admin objects.

tasks.title: Concurrency & Transaction Review
tasks.objective: Audit match, coins, referrals, message archival, reports, and deletion operations for atomicity/idempotency.
acceptance: Known critical race conditions have deterministic outcomes.
Duplicate Telegram updates cannot duplicate critical effects.

tasks.title: Background Workers & Retries
tasks.objective: Implement workers for deletion, exports, broadcasts, retryable delivery, statistics, moderation, referral qualification, and cleanup as needed.
acceptance: Heavy tasks do not block user-facing handlers.
Retries are idempotent.

tasks.title: Redis/Restart Failure Safety
tasks.objective: Define and test recovery when Redis is lost or application processes restart.
acceptance: No duplicate active match is created after recovery.
Durable data remains authoritative.

tasks.title: Secrets, Backups & Access Controls
tasks.objective: Harden secret storage, DB/Redis network access, backup encryption, restore tests, and environment separation.
acceptance: Credentials are not committed.
Backup restoration is tested.
Privileged stores are access-restricted.

tasks.title: Structured Logging
tasks.objective: Implement application/error/event logging without duplicating private conversation content into generic logs.
acceptance: Sensitive content is minimized in generic logs.
Failures have traceable context.

tasks.title: Monitoring & Health Checks
tasks.objective: Monitor bot, Telegram API, PostgreSQL, Redis, workers, queues, delivery latency, errors, backups, and abuse anomalies.
acceptance: Core dependencies and worker health are observable.
Backup failures are visible.

tasks.title: System Configuration & Feature Flags
tasks.objective: Move business settings and rollout controls to database-backed configuration with safe admin access.
acceptance: Business settings are not hard-coded.
Changes are authorized and audited.

tasks.title: Analytics Events
tasks.objective: Implement defined product analytics events with privacy-aware payloads.
acceptance: Core registration/profile/anonymous/match/chat/moderation/economy events are recorded consistently.

tasks.title: Indexes & Pagination Review
tasks.objective: Add required database indexes and enforce pagination in all large user/admin histories.
acceptance: No large unbounded history is loaded into one Telegram response.
Critical query paths have supporting indexes.

tasks.title: Maintenance Mode & Operational Controls
tasks.objective: Implement maintenance mode and safe operational switches while preserving admin access.
acceptance: Users receive maintenance response while admins retain access.

tasks.title: Protected Chat
tasks.objective: Implement per-session Telegram protected-content delivery with clear non-E2E wording and chosen consent policy.
acceptance: Protected mode is session-scoped.
Only future messages are protected as designed.
UI never calls it end-to-end encrypted.

tasks.title: Rich Media Chat & Anonymous Media
tasks.objective: Add photo/voice/video/video-note/audio/sticker/GIF/document support with privacy and moderation controls.
acceptance: Media mappings support deletion/audit.
Identity-leaking contact/location payloads remain controlled.

tasks.title: Location & Distance Matching
tasks.objective: Implement voluntary location collection, exact-location admin/owner access, approximate public use, and distance filters.
acceptance: Exact coordinates are never automatically shown to matched users.
Location is only collected via voluntary action.

tasks.title: Advanced Profile & Match Filters
tasks.objective: Add interests, advanced age/city/distance/photo filters, profile history UX, and related privacy settings.
acceptance: Filters integrate with eligibility and coin policy safely.

tasks.title: Secondary Moderators & Advanced Fraud
tasks.objective: Expand granular moderator roles, daily rewards, and stronger referral/abuse fraud detection.
acceptance: Restricted moderators cannot access forbidden sensitive capabilities.

tasks.title: Priority Match & Profile Boosts
tasks.objective: Add optional priority matchmaking and boost mechanics behind feature flags and ledger-backed charging.
acceptance: No priority feature bypasses safety/block/eligibility rules.

tasks.title: Reconnect & Multiple Anonymous Links
tasks.objective: Add reconnect requests and multiple independently revocable anonymous links.
acceptance: Reconnect creates a new session if a match occurs.
Links remain independently revocable.

tasks.title: Premium/Stars Monetization
tasks.objective: Add premium/Telegram Stars monetization only with ledger, entitlement, refund, and audit semantics.
acceptance: Payments cannot corrupt coin/session state.
Entitlements are auditable.

tasks.title: Recommendations, Reputation & Moderation Assistance
tasks.objective: Add recommendation scoring, reputation, and automated moderation assistance as advisory systems.
acceptance: Automated outputs do not bypass hard privacy/safety/authorization rules.

tasks.title: Advanced Analytics
tasks.objective: Add deeper funnels, cohort metrics, and operational dashboards after event quality is validated.
acceptance: Metrics are documented and reproducible from event/data sources.

tasks.title: Critical Acceptance Criteria Verification
tasks.objective: Verify all 30 PRD critical acceptance criteria with test/evidence references.
acceptance: Every criterion is PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED with evidence.
No production approval while a P0 privacy/session/deletion/admin criterion fails.

tasks.title: Privacy & Security Review
tasks.objective: Perform focused review of identity separation, admin access, exports, location, protected chat wording, secrets, and logs.
acceptance: No known Telegram identity leakage path remains.
Sensitive admin actions are permission-checked and audited.

tasks.title: Concurrency, Recovery & Load Tests
tasks.objective: Run race, retry, restart, Redis-failure, high-volume chat, match queue, deletion-batch, and ledger tests.
acceptance: Critical races are reproducible and resolved.
Recovery does not duplicate match/reward/spend effects.

tasks.title: Operational Runbook & Restore Drill
tasks.objective: Document deploy/rollback, migrations, incidents, backup restore, worker recovery, and admin emergency controls.
acceptance: A clean restore drill is recorded.
Rollback and incident ownership are explicit.

tasks.title: Release Checklist
tasks.objective: Produce final release checklist, unresolved-risk signoff, and production go/no-go decision.
acceptance: All P0 blockers are closed or explicitly rejected by owner with documented rationale.
Acceptance, security, reliability and runbook artifacts exist.
